title: Eliyan, which aims to license tech and make physical "chiplets" to ease AI chip data transfer bottlenecks, raised a $145M Series C at a $1B valuation (Stephen Nellis/Reuters)
summary: Stephen Nellis / Reuters: Eliyan, which aims to license tech and make physical “chiplets” to ease AI chip data transfer bottlenecks, raised a $145M Series C at a $1B valuation — Eliyan, a startup that aims to ease the bottlenecks in transferring data between AI chips in data centers …
